svg.aria-label: Measured payload sizes for the same Pythia-14M output-embedding update in FP32, BF16, FP8 and FP4, with and without zstd. Global commit update and complete-commit sizes share one decimal megabyte axis. The default FP32 commit stores the fragment and momentum; quantized commits also store an fp32 master and a separate update. Re-encoding round 456 does not measure the training quality of alternative formats.
svg.text: Payload size by precision and compression
The same output-embedding global commit update, re-encoded from round 456.
Quantized commits retain fp32 fragment, momentum and master, plus the update.
